reading_source: Page 1 reviewed: 発酵はっこう (doubled consonant, long vowel), 微生物びせいぶつ, 働きはたらき, 成分せいぶん, 保存性ほぞんせい, 現象げんしょう, 麹菌こうじきん, 酵母こうぼ, 乳酸菌にゅうさんきん, 酢酸菌さくさんきん, 菌きん. Topic は→わ and では→でわ checked contextually; lexical は in はっこう and はたらき retained. Phrase breaks reviewed after complete phrases. Page 2 reviewed supplied readings: 発酵中はっこうちゅう, 糖とう, たんぱく質たんぱくしつ, アミノ酸あみのさん, 分解ぶんかい, 脂肪しぼう, 酸さん, アルコールあるこーる, 旨味うまみ, 甘味あまみ, 生み出すうみだす, 食感しょっかん. All ten object を→お checked individually. Long vowels and doubled consonants preserved; these short phrases stay continuous without inserted pauses. Page 3 reviewed: 観察かんさつ, 甘味あまみ, 旨味うまみ, 増すます, 酸味さんみ, 柔らかいやわらかい, 濃くこく, 水分すいぶん, 強くつよく. コクこく retained as hiragana for speech. Title object を→お checked contextually; lexical はっこう preserved. All short change descriptions remain continuous without extra pauses. Page 4 reviewed supplied readings: 温度おんど, 湿度しつど, 時間じかん, 塩分えんぶん, 水分すいぶん, 熟成じゅくせい, 寝かせるねかせる, 混ぜるまぜる, 仕込むしこむ, 仕込みしこみ, 管理かんり. Title and 発酵を止める object を→お checked individually. Lexical はっこう and vowel length preserved. Short terms and actions remain continuous without extra pauses. Page 5 reviewed: 腐敗ふはい (lexical は retained), カビかび, 雑菌ざっきん, 傷むいたむ, 腐るくさる, 異臭いしゅう, 有益ゆうえき, 有害ゆうがい, 呼ぶよぶ. Topic 腐敗は→ふはいわ and each object 変化を→へんかお checked contextually. Existing 発酵 recording reused. Full phrase boundaries and doubled consonants reviewed. Page 6 reviewed: 自然しぜん, 甘味あまみ, 豊かゆたか, 深みふかみ, 食材しょくざい, 柔らかいやわらかい, 保存性ほぞんせい, 高まるたかまる, 風味ふうみ, 複雑ふくざつ. Lexical はっこう preserved. Short descriptions remain continuous without added pauses. Existing 旨味が増す recording reused from page 3. Page 7 reviewed: 料理人りょうりにん, 長ければながければ, 良いよい, 進み方すすみかた, 材料ざいりょう, 条件じょうけん, 酸味さんみ, 状態じょうたい, 調整ちょうせい, 大切たいせつ. Topic 発酵は→はっこうわ, ではありません→でわありません and object 状態を→じょうたいお checked individually. Lexical はっこう retained with explicit doubled k and long kō guidance. Pauses only after complete clauses or phrases. Page 8 reviewed: 見分けるみわける, 状態じょうたい, 季節きせつ, 発酵時間はっこうじかん, 足りないたりない. Topic どうかは→どうかわ, 発酵時間は→はっこうじかんわ, 時は→ときわ, これは→これわ checked contextually. Lexical はっこう preserved. Explicit hak-kō and voiced ji guidance added; pauses follow complete phrases, not before particles. Page 9 reviewed: 正常せいじょう, 一番いちばん, 進み方すすみかた, 同じおなじ, 影響えいきょう, 塩分えんぶん. スイスすいす, ハーブはーぶ and タイミングたいみんぐ reviewed; long vowels retained. Topic 香りは→かおりわ, 進み方は→すすみかたわ and objects ハーブを→はーぶお, 塩分を→えんぶんお checked individually. Lexical は in はーぶ and はっこう preserved. Pauses follow complete phrases and clauses.
notes: Pages 1–6: separate titles, vocabulary and explanations at 1.0; only main titles autoplay. Existing pages 1–5 reviewed inputs preserved. No audible listening verification claimed. Regenerated page 4 item 6 発酵時間 after a user-reported pronunciation issue. Hiragana はっこうじかん retained with explicit geminate k, long kō and voiced ji guidance. No audible listening verification claimed. Page 7 adds five practical points with separate recordings at 1.0 and title-only autoplay. All previous inputs, including the corrected 発酵時間 guidance, retained. No audible listening verification claimed. Regenerated page 6 point 4 味に深みが出る after a user-reported pronunciation issue. Correct hiragana あじにふかみがでる retained with explicit nine-mora guidance and short vowels in ふかみ. No audible listening verification claimed. Page 8 adds the first six teacher questions at 1.0, with title-only autoplay. Previous reviewed inputs and pronunciation corrections retained. No audible listening verification claimed. Complete nine-page deck: page 9 adds the final six teacher questions at 1.0 with title-only autoplay. Previous reviewed inputs and pronunciation corrections retained. No audible listening verification claimed.

Read only あじにふかみがでる once in standard Japanese, meaning the flavour develops depth. Pronounce a-ji ni fu-ka-mi ga de-ru: nine morae あ・じ・に・ふ・か・み・が・で・る. Use voiced ji and de. 深み is ふかみ (fukami), three short morae, with no long vowel and no doubled consonant. Keep あじに and ふかみが flowing naturally as complete phrases; never insert a pause before に or が. Say every mora clearly at a natural pace, without adding syllables or words. Do not add an introduction, translation or explanation.
